response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical expertise, extensive open-source contributions, and strong leadership in software development, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML modeling, and formal project management — critical for this role — and his German proficiency is only basic, falling short of the required C1 level.
strengths: Proven track record in open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple public tools
Extensive full-stack experience across languages (TypeScript, DLang, Node.js) and environments (Linux, Kubernetes)
Strong mentorship and workshop background, demonstrating ability to lead and teach technical teams
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No clear evidence of UML, architectural design, or formal IT project management experience
Lacks documented experience in client-facing architecture advisory or compliance/risk management
